$comment: MACHINE half of the /openai/v1/chat/completions + /openai/v1/models contract; the HUMAN half is openai-chat.md. The gateway inspects only what is declared here; the OpenAI Chat body is the vendor's and streams through byte-unchanged. `upstream` declares per rail the URL and credential header the fake upstream must receive. Cross-cutting requirement IDs here resolve to their one heading on anthropic-messages.md / sessions.md (rule 7).

authorization.description: the session token as a bearer — consulted first

x-api-key.description: the session token for SDKs that send x-api-key

x-opencode-session.description: the Go rail's native session id — passthrough

body.description: an OpenAI Chat Completions request; only `model` and `stream` are read

model.description: must name the session's model as the harness spells it (the wire id); absent = filled

upstream.$comment: per rail: what the fake upstream must receive for POST chat/completions. Credential placeholders name the Secret key, never a value.

provider.description: the pin on a POST body when the endpoint snapshot covers the session's model (GW-RAIL-OPENROUTER §Selection): ONE provider per attempt, the tag's base slug, fallbacks off; absent = the model has no snapshot entry (the request rides unpinned). The body's other keys are the harness's, re-serialised.

provider_slug.description: the base of an endpoint `tag` (`deepinfra/fp8` → `deepinfra`) — what `provider.order` names and the cell's provider key; a response's display name joins to it through the snapshot's `provider_name`, else by rule (lower-case, non-alphanumeric runs → `-`)

tag.description: the endpoint `tag` as the vendor spells it

provider_name.description: the display name a response's `provider` carries

quantization.description: the vendor's value (`fp4`, `fp8`, `mxfp4`, `unknown`, …); eligibility reads it against the policy ladder

p90_ms.description: `latency_last_30m.p90`; null on the public API (the MCP carries it)

in_price.description: $ per 1M prompt tokens; null = dynamic / unpriced

service_tier.description: `flex` / `priority` / null — a provider's tiers share one slug; the representative is the null-tier, shortest-tag row

endpoint_snapshot.$comment: the store's `catalog_snapshots.openrouter-endpoints` body (GW-RAIL-OPENROUTER §Selection reads it; the catalog leg — homelab#2742 — writes it): per model, the parsed rows of GET /api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints

models.description: keyed by the openrouter model id (the bare policy id)

providers_block.$comment: the policy's `rails.openrouter.providers` (GW-RAIL-OPENROUTER §Selection / §Failover) — the floors and the failover bound, every value ⚖; the loader refuses an unknown key, a floor off the ladder, a mode outside tool_choice_mode, a non-positive count

quantization_ladder.description: the vendor's `quantization` vocabulary in ascending precision; a value off it (`unknown`) is excluded

quantization_floor.description: a member of the ladder; an endpoint below it is excluded

min_rides.description: judged rides before a cell's measured clean-ride rate replaces its uptime prior

max_providers_per_request.description: one pin + at most (n − 1) failovers per request

tool_choice.description: per harness, the tool-choice modes its requests carry; an endpoint must support every one

models.$comment: GET /openai/v1/models — a passthrough on the rails that have one.

output.description: the upstream response, status + headers (minus hop-by-hop) + body bytes, relayed unchanged; `retry-after` kept on 429

complete.description: a 2xx is complete when a non-streamed body was read to its end, or a stream carried its terminal event; otherwise the request row's `incomplete` names the reason

session-unknown.description: no session token, or a token no row's hash matches

session-released.description: the session was released by DELETE /sessions/{id}

credential-unresolved.description: the session's rail credential is a definitive miss

credential-transient.description: the kube API failed or was unreachable while resolving the session's credential; retry

model-not-session.description: the body's model is not the session's model

dialect-unsupported-on-rail.description: the session's rail does not speak the openai dialect (the anthropic rail)

upstream-auth.description: the upstream answered 401, or 403 naming a credential reason — the rail credential is bad (marked rejected for admission); 4xx so no harness retries it; the upstream body is never relayed

upstream-refused.description: a 403 that names no credential reason — a policy refusal of this model/request; the credential is untouched; the body is never relayed

upstream-edge-refused.description: a 401/403 alternative: a 403 with no readable JSON error object (an HTML block page, Cloudflare `error code: 1010`) — an edge in front of the vendor judged THIS request's client signature; request-scoped, the credential is untouched; the body is never relayed

upstream-unreachable.description: the upstream connection failed for a reason that is not a timeout (DNS, refused, TLS, reset); nothing reached the vendor

upstream-content-type.description: the provider order exhausted on a 2xx whose body is not one the dialect reads (content-type neither JSON nor SSE — an edge's page behind a 200); a pinned attempt before the last fails over on it instead (GW-RAIL-OPENROUTER §Failover)

header-refused.description: a credential-shaped value in a header the gateway does not own — refused before any upstream call (the FU-251 tripwire)
